We have noticed in our Kong Gateway nodes times when common endpoints throw 404 route not found on a % of API calls... nothing in Kong logging catches anything of interest when we notice issue presenting itself.

To us the behavior points to cache rebuilding during new resource creation... production has not seen this issue with identical Kong configurations, but production has fewer proxies and lower frequency of new services/routes.
